# The reported changes come from different settings [1][2]

---

<!-- layout: compare -->
## The reported changes come from different settings [1][2]

| Record | Setting | Reported change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Study A | Supervised laboratory [1] | 12% [1] |
| Study B | Field use [2] | 3% [2] |

The records do not isolate the difference or support a pooled estimate. [3]

outline.heading: The reported changes come from different settings [1][2]
outline.goal: Explain the synthetic source and its scope

citations.quote: In synthetic study A, the reported change was 12% in a supervised laboratory setting. It did not evaluate field use.
In synthetic study B, the reported change was 3% during field use. It did not use the laboratory supervision from study A.
The two studies used different settings. Their records do not isolate the reason for the difference. They do not support a pooled estimate or a declaration that one method is better.
